understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid through all levels and activate every goal by stepping onto each goal cell while the carried piece has the required shape, color, and rotation.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions and walls can block movement. Shape, color, and rotation modifiers change the carried piece’s attributes; rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. A goal activates only when all three attributes match its requirements. Movement consumes stamina, and exhausting stamina costs a life; losing all lives ends the game.
